visual.description: Dark bg (#1A1824). A list appears item by item, each with a strikethrough or 'NOT INCLUDED' stamp in muted text (#rgba(232,224,212,0.6)): '❌ Cardiovascular costs', '❌ Diabetes treatment', '❌ Accident liability'. Then at bottom, a single line in accent #D47FA6 pulses: 'RAND measured ONLY lost labour. The real cost is larger.' Clean, stark — lets the omission speak for itself.
visual.textOverlay:
RAND measured ONLY lost labour.
The real cost is larger.

notes: Section closer — sets up Act 3 by establishing that even the $680B figure is an undercount. Fade transition to Act 3.
